title: Notifications
description: GOTCHA tells you when something needs a decision or something broke. On this device it can also chime, or show a desktop notification, when a customer writes.

device.title: On this device
device.note: Kept in this browser only. Your other devices and browsers keep their own.
device.notKept: This browser isn't keeping settings, so these go back to how they were when the page reloads.

sound.label: Sound for incoming messages
sound.about: A short chime when a customer writes, unless that conversation is open in front of you.

desktop.label: Desktop notifications
desktop.about: A notification at the side of the screen when a customer writes, whatever tab or app you're in, while GOTCHA is open in this browser.
desktop.blocked: Blocked in this browser - allow it in the site settings
desktop.unsupported: This browser has no desktop notifications.
desktop.notAllowed: Still off: the browser wasn't given permission. Turn it on again to be asked.

heading: Who hears about what

rules.unavailable: We couldn't read your notification rules just now.
rules.noneLead: No rules yet, so GOTCHA uses its own: an assignment reaches the person assigned; approvals, failures, campaigns and billing reach admins. In the app only - email goes only where a rule sends it.
rules.noneBody: A rule says who hears about an event, and on which channels. Here's everything GOTCHA can tell you about.

conversation.assigned: A conversation is handed to someone

integration.check_failed: A business system's credentials were rejected
Fires when someone runs a connection test and the credentials are rejected - not continuous monitoring, and not "the provider is down".

conversation.assigned: Only when a conversation is handed to someone else. Never when they pick one up themselves.

broadcast.completed: When every recipient has reached a final state - including the ones that failed.

recipient.department_manager: the manager of the team involved

scope.unknownTeam: A team we can't name - it may have been deleted

flag.disabled: Switched off. With no other rule for this event, GOTCHA's own route applies - in the app only.
flag.shadowed: Not used for a team that has its own rule for this event. GOTCHA uses the team's rule instead of this one - never both.
flag.unfiring: GOTCHA never raises this event, so this rule can never fire.
flag.unknownEvent: GOTCHA doesn't raise an event by this name. It was accepted when it was saved, and it will never match anything.
flag.undeliverable: {count, plural, =1 {{channels} can be saved but is never delivered.} other {{channels} can be saved but are never delivered.}}
flag.deliversNothing: Every channel on this rule is one GOTCHA never delivers, so it tells nobody.
flag.unresolvedRecipients: {count, plural, =1 {One named person no longer has an account here.} other {# named people no longer have accounts here.}}

row.assigned: A conversation is assigned to me

matrix.foot: Your switches filter what reaches you. Who is told at all is <rules>the workspace's rules</rules>. With no rule for an event, an assignment reaches the person assigned and the rest above reach admins, in the app. Email goes only where a rule sends it.

quiet.title: Quiet hours
quiet.note: One window, every day, in the workspace's time zone. Inside it no email is sent - in-app still arrives, quietly - except for a refund or discount that failed.
quiet.same: From and to can't be the same time.

problem.invalid: That window isn't one the platform keeps - 24-hour times, and not the same twice.
problem.forbidden: This account has no preferences of its own.

whatsapp.title: Where WhatsApp alerts go
whatsapp.note: Your own number, once WhatsApp alerts are available - they aren't yet.

volume.atLeast: You get at least {n} a day
volume.unknown: How many you get isn't known
volume.nothing: Nothing reached you in the last {days} days.

about.actionFailed: A refund or cancellation didn't go through

matrix.cellWhy: Set by the switch at the top of its column

saveProblem.forbidden: This account has no preferences of its own.
saveProblem.unknown: This notification isn't available any more.

whatsappUnavailable.why: WhatsApp alerts to you aren't available yet - there is no number for GOTCHA to send them from.

matrix.notByEmail: Not sent by email in this workspace
matrix.notInApp: Doesn't reach you in the app in this workspace

rulesPage.title: The workspace's rules
rulesPage.description: Who is told at all. Each person's own channels then filter what reaches them.
